CRATEPOP.HUDRemove: Stop this being a loot crate
CRATEPOP.KeyOpen: Open the loot crate under the mouse
CRATEPOP.KeyOpenHint: Hover over a crate and press this key, if double-clicking doesn't open it.
CRATEPOP.EmptyGM: Empty. Drag items here from the sidebar, a compendium or a sheet.
CRATEPOP.DropHint: Drag items here to add them
CRATEPOP.TakingTo: Taking to {name}. Or drag onto any sheet you own.
CRATEPOP.NoTarget: No character to give it to. Drag the item onto your character sheet instead.
CRATEPOP.DropOnSheet: Drop it on a character sheet, a character in the Actors sidebar, or your token.
CRATEPOP.OnlyItems: Only items can go in a crate.
CRATEPOP.OnlyGMAdds: Only the GM can put things in a crate.

Errors.noGM: A GM needs to be logged in to hand out loot.
Errors.timeout: The GM didn't answer in time. Try again.
Errors.noContainer: That crate isn't there any more.
Errors.grantFailed: Couldn't add it to the sheet, so it was put back in the crate.
Errors.lost: Couldn't add it or put it back. The GM's console (F12) has the item's details.
Errors.notActiveGM: Sent to the wrong GM. Try again.
Errors.error: Something went wrong. The console (F12) has details.
